items.body:
<details open>

llama : avoid touching unused graph metadata pages (#32043)

Each graph result reserves metadata for max_nodes, but many graphs use
only a fraction of that capacity.  The vector resize initializes the
whole reserve and makes otherwise unused pages resident.  Allocate the
reserve with new uint8_t[] instead.

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

sycl : use cached device-id in set_main_device (#32013)

ggml_sycl_set_main_device() runs at the start of every graph compute. Its
early-return check called dpct::get_current_device_id(), which locks the
device manager mutex and looks up the thread-to-device map. Use the
thread-local cached id that the rest of the backend already uses.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Co-authored-by: zhaoyshine <zhaoyshine@users.noreply.github.com>

</details>
